TLS Protocol Specification v1.3

Abstract
This document specifies version 1.3 of the Transport Layer Security (TLS)
protocol. See also RFC 8446. The handshake and certificate exchange are
described in section 4.2. Figure 1 shows the message flow.

Note: Implementations MUST support AES-GCM. Refer to Appendix A for
cipher suites. The API for openssl s_client is illustrative only.
